notes: Home: compact location status; single-line exchange rate and rate date beside itinerary selector; half-height previous/current/next buttons. Packing uses pale pastel sections and editable per-trip memo text areas. Manage imports trips from one plain-text field, removing photo OCR and structured-file intake buttons. Each imported trip is stored as a separate selectable trip; matching dated flights/hotels also appear in the relevant schedule day while detailed air/hotel sections remain available.
